title: Anoikis-related signature in liver hepatocellular carcinoma defines the YBX1/SPP1 axis by machine learning strategies and valid experiments.
authors: Ma, Ying; She, Xingguo; Zhao, Jie; Liu, Shu; Li, Cai; Wang, Qiang
one_liner_zh: 该文利用机器学习构建肝癌失巢凋亡相关评分并验证YBX1/SPP1轴，但核心是肿瘤预后与免疫，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，仅方法上机器学习可借鉴，与课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC) remains a malignant malignancy with a low cure rate. Anoikis is a newly recognized cancer hallmark. However, an Anoikis-related model has not been clarified in LIHC. METHODS: The Anoikis-related score in the present study was created using Survival Random Forest and least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) machine learning algorithms. Anoikis-related scores with respect to mutation analysis, immunological analysis, function annotation, and medication prediction were all thoroughly investigated. RESULTS: The Anoikis-related score accurately predicted the patients' immunological activity, altered genes, and medication sensitivity. SPP1 immunological analysis, function annotation, medication prediction, and immunotherapy prediction were systematically investigated. SPP1 may effectively predict the outcomes of immunotherapy. SPP1 was revealed to be a mediator of LIHC cell proliferation and migration. A putative axis in LIHC was YBX1/SPP1. CONCLUSIONS: Clinical care and the treatment plan for patients with LIHC were anticipated to benefit significantly from the established Anoikis-related score.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞肝癌（LIHC）仍是一种治愈率较低的恶性肿瘤。失巢凋亡（Anoikis）是新近公认的癌症标志。然而，在LIHC中，与失巢凋亡相关的模型尚未明确。方法：本研究中的失巢凋亡相关评分采用生存随机森林和最小绝对收缩与选择算子（LASSO）机器学习算法构建。对失巢凋亡相关评分在突变分析、免疫学分析、功能注释和药物预测方面进行了全面研究。结果：失巢凋亡相关评分准确预测了患者的免疫活性、突变基因和药物敏感性。对SPP1的免疫学分析、功能注释、药物预测和免疫治疗预测进行了系统研究。SPP1可能有效预测免疫治疗的结果。SPP1被揭示为LIHC细胞增殖和迁移的介导因子。在LIHC中，一个推测的轴为YBX1/SPP1。结论：所建立的失巢凋亡相关评分预计将显著有益于LIHC患者的临床护理和治疗方案。
